title: The last Qing emperor abdicates
summary: Empress Dowager Longyu issued an edict on behalf of the six-year-old Puyi, abdicating the throne and transferring power to the Republic of China.
reason: After the revolution, Yuan Shikai negotiated the abdication in exchange for becoming president of the republic.
significance: It ended the Qing dynasty and over two millennia of imperial rule in China.
